card.name: Small linking words before patient
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, the, and, or, to) that come right before a reference to the patient, caregiver or fetus. They appear in dosing and instruction sentences.

modes.label: By/to before patient
modes.description: A preposition sits right before the word patient.
modes.example: first dose of oral immediate-release carbidopa-levodopa that was taken<< by>> the patient on the previous day.

modes.label: Missed-dose clause
modes.description: The word the after a comma in a missed-dose instruction, before dose or patient.
modes.example: If a dose of ONGENTYS is missed,<< the>> next dose should be taken at the scheduled

modes.label: Patients and caregivers
modes.description: And or or joins patients with caregivers or mothers with the fetus.
modes.example: Risk Mitigation Strategies for Hypoglycemia Patients<< and>> caregivers must be educated to recognize and manage

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly odd or foreign pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the text names who takes or gives the medicine, such as the patient or caregiver.
